description: This file contains jQuery plugin definitions for various UI steps and utilities used in an admin setup process, including loading images, form steps, AJAX job handling, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, preloads images, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: updateCheckTable
methods.description: Updates the visibility of check items and sections based on view mode.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Switches between login and signup forms based on user selection.

methods.name: toggleSocketInput
methods.description: Enables or disables database host, port, and socket inputs based on socket checkbox.

methods.name: switchDbTypes
methods.description: Adjusts database port and table type inputs based on selected database type.

methods.name: showLoader
methods.description: Displays a modal loader with a message.
